exposure: Hysterectomy for benign indications performed by benign gynecologists
Hysterectomy for benign indications performed by gynecologic oncologists
cohort: 198,767 patients undergoing hysterectomy for benign indications from the National Surgical Quality Improvement Program data from 2014 to 2021
finding: While gynecologic oncologists are performing more hysterectomies for benign indications on higher-risk patients, matched cohort analysis showed similar rates of major complications between gynecologic oncologists and benign gynecologists.
